chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

The sick person performs salat (prayer) standing; if he is not able, he performs salat (prayer) sitting. If he is not able, he performs salat (prayer) on his right side; if he is not able, he performs salat (prayer) on his left side. If he is not able, he lies down and gestures by indication, and he places his face toward the qiblah, and makes his sajdah lower than his ruku'.

key_terms.الْمَرِيضُ: the sick person whose physical condition affects the manner of prayer
key_terms.جَالِسًا: sitting for prayer when standing is not possible
key_terms.جَنْبِهِ الْأَيْمَنِ: his right side, as a bodily position for prayer

ai.seo_question: How should a sick person perform salat (prayer) if unable to stand or sit?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out the graded manner in which a sick person performs salat (prayer) according to ability. It establishes ease in worship while preserving orientation toward the qiblah and distinction between ruku' and sajdah even through gestures.
